item.title: Vietnam: Blending Heritage and Technology Through Digital Lì Xì
item.description: Vietnam’s traditional Tet practice of giving lì xì red envelopes is rapidly evolving as digital platforms enable convenient, personalised, interactive, festive and cashless lucky money exchanges for families nationwide.

item.title: Malaysia, UK Partnership Drives Smart AI and Digital Innovation
item.description: Malaysia is partnering with the UK to accelerate digital innovation, trusted AI, cybersecurity, sustainable infrastructure and regional tech integration, boosting competitiveness and resilient growth.

item.title: Thailand: Smart e-Nose Technology Targets PM2.5 Pollution
item.description: Thailand has launched 100 smart “e-Nose” sensors using AI and nanotechnology to accurately identify PM2.5 pollution sources from farms and industries and support targeted, data-driven air quality policies.

item.title: Australia: Melbourne Launches AI and Digital Engineering Hub
item.description: Victoria has launched a new AI and digital engineering hub in Melbourne, creating 150 high-skilled technology roles and significantly strengthening the state’s innovation, agritech and digital technology ecosystem.

item.title: India, Sweden Deepen Strategic Telecom and Digital Partnership
item.description: India and Sweden have strengthened their strategic partnership in telecommunications and digital technologies, focusing on 5G and 6G development, secure networks, digital infrastructure and inclusive innovation.

item.title: Australian Cyber Security Centre Releases Quantum Primer
item.description: Australia’s latest quantum computing primer outlines emerging future cybersecurity risks, encryption challenges and the urgent need for early preparation to strengthen national digital infrastructure resilience.

item.title: Malaysia: Cybersecurity, Connectivity for a Resilient Digital Economy
item.description: Malaysia is investing US$7.1 million to strengthen cybersecurity platforms and digital connectivity, enhancing national resilience and supporting secure, scalable cross-border technology and digital services.

item.title: India Leads Global Effort in Responsible, Inclusive AI Adoption
item.description: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 brought global leaders together to explore responsible AI deployment, emphasising infrastructure, governance, collaboration and ethical innovation for societal and economic benefit.

item.title: Hong Kong: New Advances In Smart Protective Technology
item.description: Four NAMI technologies advance materials, healthcare, impact protection and anti-counterfeit security, demonstrating applied innovation across industries with scalable real-world applications.

item.title: Vietnam: Financial Industry Fast-Tracks AI Adoption, Integration
item.description: Vietnam’s financial institutions are accelerating AI adoption and cloud modernisation to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen cybersecurity, improve resilience and deliver more personalised digital banking.
